knowledge:
- key_parameters: assembly1Fn/assembly2Fn=Paths to the 2bit genome assembly files; order is important as assembly1 is the reference ;; axt12Fn/axt21Fn=Paths to the Axt alignment files with assembly1 and assembly2 as reference, respectively ;; cutoffs1/cutoffs2=Maximal number of hits allowed during realignment (BLAT) to filter out repeats (e.g., higher for duplicated genomes like zebrafish) ;; window/identity=Parameters for scanning alignments (e.g., window size of 50 and identity threshold of 45/50, 48/50, or 49/50) ;; tFilter/qFilter=GRanges objects containing regions to filter out (exons, repeats) for target and query genomes ;; distance=Scoring matrix parameter in lastz or lastal (e.g., "far" for distant species)
- alternatives: last (via lastal)=Recommended over lastz when genome assemblies are highly fragmented (many scaffolds/chromosomes) because it is faster and more memory efficient ;; YASS=Mentioned as a potential future alternative aligner ;; ggbio=Mentioned as an alternative to Gviz for visualization using ggplot2-style tracks
- when_to_use: Appropriate when identifying conserved noncoding elements (CNEs) from scratch using whole-genome pairwise alignments of two species, especially when studying evolutionary dynamics, developmental regulation, or identifying novel unannotated genes.
- pitfalls: Running lastz on highly fragmented assemblies can overwhelm the aligner with reading small pieces, leading to performance issues (use last instead) ;; The order of assemblies when creating the CNE object is critical; axt12Fn must have assembly1 as reference, and axt21Fn must have assembly2 as reference ;; The realignment step (blatCNE) can be extremely time-consuming when the number of CNEs is large ;; Kent's utilities (and thus the alignment generation pipeline) do not support Windows; this part of the pipeline only works on Linux and Unix.

workflows.name: pairwise_genome_alignment
workflows.intent: Generate pairwise whole-genome net alignments (.net.axt files) from 2bit or fasta files using LASTZ and Kent utilities.
workflows.stages: 1. Run LASTZ alignment to generate LAV files ;; 2. Convert LAV files to PSL files ;; 3. Join close alignments into chains ;; 4. Sort and combine chains ;; 5. Filter chains ;; 6. Net chains and add synteny information ;; 7. Create net.axt files
workflows.code:
lavs <- lastz(assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery, outputDir=axtDir, chrsTarget=c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3"), chrsQuery=c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3"), distance="far", mc.cores=4)
psls <- lavToPsl(lavs, removeLav=FALSE, binary="lavToPsl")
chains <- axtChain(psls, assemblyTarget=assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery=assemblyQuery, distance="far", removePsl=FALSE, binary="axtChain")
allChain <- chainMergeSort(chains, assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery, allChain=file.path(axtDir, paste0(sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyTarget), ignore.case=TRUE), ".", sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyQuery), ignore.case=TRUE), ".all.chain")), removeChains=FALSE, binary="chainMergeSort")
allPreChain <- chainPreNet(allChain, assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery, allPreChain=file.path(axtDir, paste0(sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyTarget), ignore.case = TRUE), ".", sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyQuery), ignore.case = TRUE), ".all.pre.chain")), removeAllChain=FALSE, binary="chainPreNet")
netSyntenicFile <- chainNetSyntenic(allPreChain, assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery, netSyntenicFile=file.path(axtDir, paste0(sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyTarget), ignore.case = TRUE), ".", sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyQuery), ignore.case = TRUE), ".noClass.net")), binaryChainNet="chainNet", binaryNetSyntenic="netSyntenic")
netToAxt(netSyntenicFile, allPreChain, assemblyTarget, assemblyQuery, axtFile=file.path(axtDir, paste0(sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyTarget), ignore.case = TRUE), ".", sub("\\.2bit$", "", basename(assemblyQuery), ignore.case = TRUE), ".net.axt")), removeFiles=FALSE, binaryNetToAxt="netToAxt", binaryAxtSort="axtSort")

workflows.name: cne_identification_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Identify, filter, merge, store, and visualize conserved noncoding elements (CNEs) from pairwise Axt alignments and genomic filter regions.
input: hg38.danRer10.net.axt (Axt alignment with hg38 as reference)
danRer10.hg38.net.axt (Axt alignment with danRer10 as reference)
workflows.stages: 1. Read Axt alignments ;; 2. Read filter regions from BED files ;; 3. Create a CNE class object ;; 4. Scan alignments for conserved regions ;; 5. Merge overlapping elements ;; 6. Realign CNEs to filter out unannotated repeats ;; 7. Save CNEs to a local SQLite database ;; 8. Query CNEs from SQLite ;; 9. Plot CNE width and genomic distribution ;; 10. Calculate CNE density ;; 11. Visualize CNE density using Gviz horizon plots
workflows.code:
axtHg38DanRer10 <- readAxt(axtFilesHg38DanRer10)
axtDanRer10Hg38 <- readAxt(axtFilesDanRer10Hg38)
danRer10Filter <- readBed(bedDanRer10Fn)
hg38Filter <- readBed(bedHg38Fn)
cneDanRer10Hg38 <- CNE(
  assembly1Fn=file.path(system.file("extdata",
                                    package="BSgenome.Drerio.UCSC.danRer10"),
                        "single_sequences.2bit"),
  assembly2Fn=file.path(system.file("extdata",
                                    package="BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38"),
                        "single_sequences.2bit"),
  axt12Fn=axtFilesDanRer10Hg38, axt21Fn=axtFilesHg38DanRer10,
  cutoffs1=8L, cutoffs2=4L)
cneListDanRer10Hg38 <- ceScan(x=cneDanRer10Hg38, tFilter=danRer10Filter,
                              qFilter=hg38Filter,
                              window=windows, identity=identities)
cneMergedListDanRer10Hg38 <- lapply(cneListDanRer10Hg38, cneMerge)
cneFinalListDanRer10Hg38 <- lapply(cneMergedListDanRer10Hg38, blatCNE)
saveCNEToSQLite(cneFinalListDanRer10Hg38[[i]], dbName, tableNames[i],
                overwrite=TRUE)
fetchedCNERanges <- readCNERangesFromSQLite(dbName, tableName, chr, 
                                            start, end, whichAssembly="first",
                                            minLength=minLength)
plotCNEWidth(cneGRangePairs)
plotCNEDistribution(first(cneGRangePairs))
cneDanRer10Hg38_21_30 <- 
  CNEDensity(dbName=dbName, 
             tableName="danRer10_hg38_21_30",
             whichAssembly="first", chr=chr, start=start,
             end=end, windowSize=windowSize, 
             minLength=minLength)
dTrack1 <- DataTrack(range=cneDanRer10Hg38_21_30,
                     genome=genome, type="horiz", 
                     horizon.scale=max(cneDanRer10Hg38_21_30$score)/3, 
                     fill.horizon=c("#B41414", "#E03231", "#F7A99C", 
                                    "yellow", "orange", "red"), 
                     name="human 21/30", background.title="brown")
ht <- HighlightTrack(trackList=list(refGenes, dTrack5, dTrack4, 
                                    dTrack1, dTrack2, dTrack3), 
                     start=c(24200000, 25200000, 26200000), 
                     end=c(25100000, 26150000, 27000000),
                     chromosome =chr)
plotTracks(list(axisTrack, cpgIslands, ht),
           collapseTranscripts=TRUE, shape="arrow",
           transcriptAnnotation="symbol",
           from=24000000, to=27000000)
